answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is a recurring work-and-review gate. Every identity must produce fresh computation and an original answer each epoch, then receive attestations from established peers. Its history is a public vault of evidence, while reputation decays in a spiral when it stops contributing. A raven-like burst of cheap accounts cannot gain weight because each fake head must repeatedly pay the same compute cost and survive independent review; mass identities therefore cost more than their possible rewards.
